hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Broad cross-asset stress and elevated institutional advisory risk warrant defensive sizing. BTC is the strongest and most liquid signal, but its edge is modest; ETH and SOL have weak positive composites alongside higher beta, volatility, and downside expected shortfall. BCH, DOGE, and LTC are fragile due to negative composites, weak alpha, or poor liquidity. ETC is untradable-looking and data-invalid with zero price, volatility, and liquidity metrics; its long signal should not be relied upon.
